CustomField.description: When the nightly Import row cleanup deletes the staged rows of a complete import: Once_Complete, After_30_Days, After_90_Days or Never (R-IR5). Text rather than a picklist because custom settings do not support picklists (ADR-0019); blank reads as After_30_Days.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the rows of a complete import are deleted: once complete, after 30 days, after 90 days, or never.
CustomField.label: Delete Import Rows
